title: Select the Flagship Composition for OpenPulse
question: Three high-fidelity compositional directions have been created under the Precision Instrument Bench world. Which composition should serve as the primary north-star layout for implementation?

options.label: Option 1: Real-Time Waveform & Live Event Stream
options.thesis: Real-time telemetry pulse bench with etched graticule sparkline waveform, 4 core KPI stat cards, and high-density live event stream table.
options.viewport: Top KPI cards, central event throughput waveform, and bottom live event log with status pills.

options.label: Option 2: Split-Pane Telemetry & Live Event Inspector
options.thesis: Split-pane investigation layout pairing multi-channel metric graphs with a persistent slide-out JSON event payload inspector and latency breakdown.
options.viewport: Multi-metric query grid on the left, full raw event payload drawer on the right.

options.label: Option 3: Conversion Funnels & Cohort Retention Heatmap
options.thesis: Deep conversion and retention analytics featuring horizontal step drop-off funnels, cohort retention heatmap matrix, and release health correlation.
options.viewport: Top funnel drop-off steps, middle weekly retention matrix, bottom release crash-rate correlation.
